description: Get one app's captured flows (onboarding, paywall, features...) in the order a user meets them, every screen numbered by step with its name, summary, on-screen text, main button and image, so a flow can be rebuilt screen by screen; paywall screens we have read also give paywall: their plans, prices, trial days, preselected plan, close and main button. captured_at, app_version and run_id say which capture the screens come from (null when not recorded); get_design_history has the older captures. The first page also gives walkthroughs: the app's full session recordings, one MP4 per part (guest, signed-in, sign-up...). Each flow gives its animation clips and, on some older captures only, a recording of that flow alone. Every animation clip and flow recording is an MP4 with still frames (frames: time in seconds and image URL) so the motion can be seen without playing the video; frames is empty for a clip not cut into stills yet. Flows come in recording order and keep their flow_no whatever the filter; use pattern for one kind (onboarding is usually what to copy first) or flow_no for one flow. Get the app_id from list_design_apps or search_designs. Needs an active Social Growth Engineers subscription; other keys are refused.

app_id.description: App Store ID of an app we captured (from list_design_apps or search_designs)

flow_no.description: Only this flow (its flow_no from a previous answer)

frames.description: Include the still frames of each clip (default: true)

offset.description: Flows to skip, for the next page (use next_offset)

pattern.description: Only flows of this category. Default: all

name: get_app_flow
title: Get an app's flows in order
